name: 89 North Music Venue

evidence.note: Venue's own Country Night listing: DJ, live bands and line dance instruction, dancing 7:30-10:30 PM, no experience needed.
Reviewer compares it to a classic rock club with tables around the stage and room for dancing.
A Yelp reviewer says there is plenty of room to hang out or dance.
A January 2026 review says they have done both standing-room and seated shows and there is room for dancing.

dancing.notes: There is open floor in front of the stage where people dance at band shows. On Wednesday country nights an instructor teaches line dances and beginners are welcome.

description: A live music club in downtown Patchogue with a stage, a big bar, table seating and standing room. It books tribute and rock bands on weekends and runs a weekly country night.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Oct 3 is a metal tribute night (Slayer and Metallica tributes), so expect a standing rock crowd, not social dancing. A review summary says the venue discourages moshing.
